text:
Maria Chen: Morning async — preflight check for canary (1% us-east-1). What I did: validated healthchecks, smoke tests passed, promoted image tag v2.3. Blockers: routing middleware PR needs one more approving review (PR #4567), seeing intermittent redis TTL failures in staging logs. Today: watch metrics and post 30m snapshot.

Alex Patel: I can review PR #4567 this afternoon. pinged you on the PR with context notes. Quick Q: is there a fallback route if middleware fails?

Maria Chen: yes — fallback to v2.2 routing is configured via FF ff-routing-fallback. We'll keep it enabled until 10m stable window.

Sam Ortiz: ops — raised circuit-breaker timeout to 600ms for canary, bumped pod replicas to 4 in us-east-1 slice. Added temporary alert: monitor_kv_errors >= 10 -> page oncall.

deploy-bot: Deployment started for canary slice us-east-1, image=redwood-inference:v2.3 :rocket:

Jin Seo: Happy to run eval harness on the canary traffic. Which prompt set?

Maria Chen: Use regression-smoke-2026 and quick-entailment-50. Run at 20k token cap and paste summary. If you see >3% hallucination on entailment, hold the flag.

Alex Patel: FYI PR https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/4567 — left one suggestion in middleware for null header case.

Sam Ortiz: Observability note — 99p latency increased to 220ms at t+12m, error rate steady at 0.12% (within SLO). I added an emergency route rule to divert on spike. Commands:
```
# toggle feature flag to off for canary
curl -X POST "https://console.redwood/api/flags/ff-user-facing-ui-v2/toggle" -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" -d '{"state":"off","env":"canary"}'

# rollback command
rdeploy rollback --env canary --to-tag v2.2
```

Maria Chen: leaving this thread open — will post 30m snapshot. If anyone sees sustained error or latency >250ms, call pager and flip ff-routing-fallback.

Alex Patel: I'll try to get the PR done in the next 2h, ping me if you want me to take the rollback.

Jin Seo: starting eval run now, will paste results in ~18m.
